items.description: mamba-ssm c++20 patch pipeline — rework scripts/install_mamba.sh and the CI test-mamba/example-nightly install lines to build mamba-ssm 2.3.2.post1 from the sha256-verified sdist (104cc47e9101e5401a675fa2b784f2952b9b037f3b1dd83b5ac544394e95d028) with the four -std=c++17 to -std=c++20 setup.py edits (upstream PR 1000 equivalent), replacing the guessed-URL wheel path that can never serve torch 2.11+ on aarch64; reproducible and TUNA-mirror compatible for the GB10 runner
torch ceiling raise — pyproject.toml seven torch bounds <2.12 to <2.15 as one commit citing GitHub run 40140203118; depends on item 1 landing first

v1.4 lazy-facade shim regression — plain `import dnallm` must again activate the transformers_compat remote-code pruning helpers (Phase 25 PEP 562 facade dropped the eager subpackage imports that ran apply_patches); the notebook contract `import dnallm` activating compat must hold again; ship with a regression test that is red on v1.4 tip and green after the fix
